author: homelab
name: SSH authorized_keys write (Linux, auditd)
description: A write to an authorized_keys file, seen by the auditd ssh_authkeys watch. Elastic Defend on Linux emits file creation/deletion/rename but not modification, so an in-place rewrite (T1098.004) is invisible to Defend and to the prebuilt 'SSH Authorized Keys File Activity' rule (it keys on event.type:change). This rule relies on the auditd write-watch instead. Verified 2026-10-17 on lab-ubu01.
query: file where host.os.type == "linux" and event.dataset == "auditd_manager.auditd" and (file.path like "*/authorized_keys" or file.path like "*/authorized_keys2")
